Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

The dilemma of needing to use bulky and outdated straps or belts to carry multiple long-weapons simultaneously has finally been solved — and being offered commercially. This advanced chest holster has a nanobattery powered magnetic mount, capable of reliably holding any metallic object from a knife to an anti-material rifle.

Allows the user to swap between 2 Two-Handed Weapons with a single Action as long as this item is worn on the outside of any worn clothing and armor, which stores the unused weapon on their back. While a weapon is stored in this manner, it cannot be concealed in any way.

While this does allow for carrying the stored weapon, it does not mean it is permanently attached, meaning large crashes or impacts — such as Throws, hefty Melee Attacks, etc — at GM discretion can still knock the stored weapon away. While a weapon is stored in this holster, it is still counted as wielded for the purposes of any BODY related checks it may have and any possible penalties those may apply.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > General Gear).
